message.content:
I don’t have direct access to an external geocoding service from within this environment, so I can’t make a live API call to look up the address for those coordinates. However, you can easily get the address yourself by using a reverse‑geocoding endpoint such as:

```text
https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with a valid Google Maps API key. The JSON response will contain the formatted address and other details.

If you prefer an open‑source alternative, you could use the Nominatim API from OpenStreetMap:

```text
https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=jsonv2&lat=37.4224764&lon=-122.0842499
```

Both services will return the human‑readable address for the given latitude and longitude.
